name: Friday Saguaro East Ride

name: Friday Social Ride (regular and casual)

Two rides leave together: a regular ride of about 20 miles and 2 hours at 10 to 14 mph, and a casual ride of 8 to 10 miles at 8 to 10 mph for people new to group rides. The Meetup series runs to Jan 1, 2027. Meetup lists Oct 2 and Oct 9, 2026.

VVCC's insurance covers members and first-time riders only, and non-members ride at their own risk after a first ride.

Everyone has coffee at the shop afterward.
